rules.statement: The fact that the Petitioner-Appellant has not signed the letter dated 21-09-2002 X 10 is not relevant as he does not have soil rights to the by-lane.
rules.supporting_quote: His right of way can continue without any hindrance even after vesting the by-lane in the Urban Council as a public road.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 52 of the Urban Councils Ordinance
